items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: The greatest musicians that I ever played with in my life that gave me the feeling, was Herschel.

ctx.x: The greatest musicians that I ever played with in my life that gave me the feeling, was Herschel. Nobody, nobody. He lifted you out of your seat. He could do it with 8 bars. Don't ask me how he did it; you just floated. You floated, and everybody had this erroneous thing about Lester and Herschel. It was like hams and eggs and bacon and eggs. And it was very difficult to keep Lester in the band after he died. He was leaving every night and he had his coat and hat on the bandstand and Jack had to pull him down…
